<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>Ghostty Playground: Ghostty Online in Your Browser</title>
    <meta name="description" content="An unofficial Ghostty playground. Run Ghostty online with Bash, Node.js and npm in your browser. Learn how BrowserPod handles commands, project files, web servers and Portal URLs." />
    <meta name="robots" content="index, follow" />

    <!-- Open Graph -->
    <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
    <meta property="og:title" content="Ghostty Playground: Ghostty Online in Your Browser" />
    <meta property="og:description" content="Run Ghostty online with Bash, Node.js and npm. BrowserPod provides commands, project files, web servers and Portal URLs inside the browser." />
    <meta property="og:site_name" content="Ghostty Playground" />
    <meta property="og:url" content="https://ghosttyplayground.com/" />
    <meta property="og:image" content="https://ghosttyplayground.com/og-image-new.jpg" />
    <meta property="og:image:width" content="1200" />
    <meta property="og:image:height" content="630" />

    <!-- Twitter -->
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
    <meta name="twitter:title" content="Ghostty Playground: Ghostty Online in Your Browser" />
    <meta name="twitter:description" content="Run Ghostty online with Bash, Node.js and npm. BrowserPod provides the browser-hosted command and project environment." />
    <meta name="twitter:image" content="https://ghosttyplayground.com/og-image-new.jpg" />

    <link rel="canonical" href="https://ghosttyplayground.com/" />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="/ghostty-icon-small.png" />
    <script type="application/ld+json">
      {
        "@context": "https://schema.org",
        "@type": "WebApplication",
        "name": "Ghostty Playground",
        "url": "https://ghosttyplayground.com/",
        "applicationCategory": "DeveloperApplication",
        "operatingSystem": "Web browser",
        "description": "A browser-based Ghostty terminal with Bash, Node.js, npm, project files, and BrowserPod."
      }
    </script>

    <!-- Establish cross-origin isolation (for SharedArrayBuffer) before the
         app module runs. Must come first in <head>. -->
    <script src="/coi-serviceworker.js"></script>
    <style>
      *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

      html {
        margin: 0;
        background: #2E2F9A;
      }
      body {
        margin: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
        color: #a9b1d6;
        background: #2E2F9A;
      }

      header {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 0 12px 0 12px;
        font-size: 13px;
        background: #2E2F9A;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        min-height: 36px;
      }
      #header-title {
        opacity: 0.8;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
      }
      #header-logo {
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;
        display: block;
      }

      #tab-bar {
        display: flex;
        align-items: stretch;
        flex: 1;
        gap: 0;
        overflow-x: auto;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        min-height: 36px;
      }
      #tab-bar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

      .tab-btn {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 0 12px;
        background: none;
        border: none;
        border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
        color: #565f89;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-family: inherit;
        cursor: pointer;
        white-space: nowrap;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        min-height: 36px;
        margin-bottom: -1px;
      }
      .tab-btn:hover { color: #a9b1d6; }
      .tab-btn.active { color: #c0caf5; border-bottom-color: #7aa2f7; }
      .tab-close {
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        border-radius: 3px;
        opacity: 0.5;
        font-size: 14px;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .tab-close:hover { opacity: 1; background: #2a2b3d; }
      #tab-add {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 0 8px;
        background: none;
        border: none;
        color: #565f89;
        font-size: 18px;
        cursor: pointer;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      #tab-add:hover { color: #a9b1d6; }

      #main {
        height: calc(100vh - 36px);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
      }

      #terminals {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        position: relative;
      }
      .terminal-instance {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        display: none;
        z-index: 1;
      }
      .terminal-instance.active {
        display: block;
      }

      .split-pane {
        position: absolute;
        overflow: hidden;
        isolation: isolate;
      }
      .pane-background-color,
      .pane-background-image {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .pane-background-color { z-index: 0; }
      .pane-background-image { z-index: 1; }
      .pane-terminal-host {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 2;
        overflow: auto;
      }
      .pane-terminal-host canvas {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
      }

      .split-divider {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 10;
        background: var(--split-divider-color, #2a2b3d);
        transition: background 0.1s;
      }
      .split-divider:hover {
        background: #565f89;
      }

      .split-pane-active {
        outline: 1px solid #7aa2f7;
        outline-offset: -1px;
      }

      html[data-window-decoration="none"] header {
        border-bottom-color: transparent;
      }
      html[data-window-decoration="none"] #header-title {
        display: none;
      }
      html[data-window-theme="light"] header {
        background-color: #f2f2f2;
        color: #24292f;
      }
      html[data-window-theme="light"] .tab-btn.active {
        color: #24292f;
      }

      #page-content {
        background: #2E2F9A;
        border-top: 1px solid #242536;
        min-height: 900px;
      }
      .pc-footer {
        padding: 28px max(48px, calc((100vw - 1144px) / 2));
        border-top: 1px solid #242536;
        background: #0f1018;
        font-size: 12px;
        color: #565f89;
        display: flex;
        gap: 20px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .pc-footer a {
        color: #565f89;
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      .pc-footer a:hover { color: #a9b1d6; }

      #portal-notifications {
        position: fixed;
        top: 48px;
        right: 12px;
        z-index: 1500;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 8px;
        width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 24px));
      }
      .portal-notice {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        min-height: 40px;
        padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px;
        border: 1px solid #3d59a1;
        border-radius: 5px;
        background: #171825;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
        color: #c0caf5;
        font: 12px/1.4 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace;
      }
      .portal-notice-label {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .portal-notice-open {
        padding: 4px 9px;
        border: 1px solid #7aa2f7;
        border-radius: 3px;
        color: #7aa2f7;
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      .portal-notice-open:hover {
        background: #1e2045;
        color: #c0caf5;
      }
      .portal-notice-close {
        border: 0;
        background: none;
        color: #737aa2;
        cursor: pointer;
        font: 18px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
      }
      .portal-notice-close:hover { color: #c0caf5; }

      /* Inspector panel — fixed overlay, slides up from bottom */
      #inspector {
        position: fixed;
        bottom: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        height: 40vh;
        min-height: 240px;
        max-height: 60vh;
        border-top: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        background: #2E2F9A;
        display: none;
        flex-direction: column;
        font-size: 12px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace;
        z-index: 500;
      }
      #inspector.visible { display: flex; }

      #inspector h2 {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 7px 14px;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        color: #565f89;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
      }

      #insp-close {
        background: none;
        border: none;
        color: #565f89;
        cursor: pointer;
        font-size: 16px;
        line-height: 1;
        padding: 0 2px;
        font-family: inherit;
      }
      #insp-close:hover { color: #c0caf5; }

      #inspector-body {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row;
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: hidden;
      }

      .inspector-section {
        padding: 0;
        border-right: 1px solid #1e1f2e;
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 160px;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }
      .inspector-section:last-child { border-right: none; }

      .inspector-section h3 {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 5px 14px 4px;
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #565f89;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        background: #0f1019;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #1e1f2e;
      }

      .inspector-section h3.with-actions {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
      }

      .inspector-section h3.with-actions .insp-actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: 4px;
      }

      .insp-btn {
        background: none;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        color: #565f89;
        border-radius: 3px;
        padding: 1px 7px;
        font-size: 10px;
        cursor: pointer;
        font-family: inherit;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      }
      .insp-btn:hover { color: #a9b1d6; border-color: #565f89; }

      .inspector-row {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: baseline;
        padding: 4px 14px;
        gap: 8px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #161720;
      }
      .inspector-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

      .inspector-row .label {
        color: #565f89;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .inspector-row .value {
        color: #c0caf5;
        font-size: 12px;
        text-align: right;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .color-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 5px 14px;
        gap: 8px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #161720;
      }
      .color-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
      .color-row .label { color: #565f89; font-size: 12px; flex: 1; }
      .color-swatch-lg {
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
        border-radius: 3px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .color-hex {
        color: #c0caf5;
        font-size: 12px;
        min-width: 64px;
        text-align: right;
      }

      .palette-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
        gap: 3px;
        padding: 10px 14px;
      }
      .palette-cell {
        aspect-ratio: 1;
        border-radius: 3px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        cursor: default;
        position: relative;
      }
      .palette-cell:hover::after {
        content: attr(title);
        position: absolute;
        bottom: calc(100% + 4px);
        left: 50%;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        background: #1a1b26;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        color: #c0caf5;
        font-size: 11px;
        padding: 2px 6px;
        border-radius: 3px;
        white-space: nowrap;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 100;
      }

      /* Context menu */
      #context-menu {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 1000;
        background: #1e1f2e;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: 4px;
        min-width: 200px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        display: none;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      #context-menu.visible { display: block; }

      .menu-item {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 6px 10px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        cursor: pointer;
        color: #a9b1d6;
        user-select: none;
      }
      .menu-item:hover { background: #2a2b3d; color: #c0caf5; }
      .menu-item.disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }
      .menu-item svg { flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0.7; }
      .menu-separator {
        height: 1px;
        background: #2a2b3d;
        margin: 3px 6px;
      }

      /* Title dialog */
      #title-dialog, #config-dialog {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 2000;
        display: none;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      }
      #title-dialog.visible, #config-dialog.visible { display: flex; }
      #title-dialog-box {
        background: #1e1f2e;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 20px;
        width: 320px;
        box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      }
      #title-dialog-box h3 {
        margin: 0 0 14px;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #c0caf5;
      }
      #title-input {
        width: 100%;
        background: #2E2F9A;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        border-radius: 4px;
        color: #c0caf5;
        font-size: 13px;
        padding: 7px 10px;
        outline: none;
        margin-bottom: 14px;
      }
      #title-input:focus { border-color: #7aa2f7; }
      #config-editor-wrap {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        margin-bottom: 14px;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background: #2E2F9A;
        min-height: 260px;
      }
      #config-editor-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #7aa2f7; }
      #config-highlight, #config-editor {
        font-family: monospace;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.5;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        margin: 0;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        word-wrap: break-word;
        tab-size: 2;
      }
      #config-highlight {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        border: none;
        background: none;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        z-index: 1;
      }
      #config-editor {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: 260px;
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        color: transparent;
        caret-color: #c0caf5;
        outline: none;
        resize: both;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        z-index: 2;
      }
      #config-dialog-box {
        background: #1e1f2e;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 20px;
        width: 480px;
        max-width: calc(100vw - 48px);
        box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      }
      #config-dialog-box h3 {
        margin: 0 0 14px;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #c0caf5;
      }
      /* Syntax token colours */
      #config-highlight { color: #c0caf5; }
      .hl-comment    { color: #565f89; }
      .hl-property   { color: #7aa2f7; }
      .hl-boolean    { color: #ff9e64; }
      .hl-number     { color: #ff9e64; }
      .hl-string     { color: #bb9af7; }
      .hl-color      { color: #7aa2f7; }
      .hl-operator   { color: #89ddff; }
      .hl-keyword    { color: #bb9af7; }
      .hl-path       { color: #e0af68; }
      .hl-keybind    { color: #f7768e; }
      .dialog-buttons {
        display: flex;
        gap: 8px;
        justify-content: flex-end;
      }
      .dialog-btn {
        padding: 6px 16px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        font-size: 13px;
        cursor: pointer;
        background: transparent;
        color: #a9b1d6;
      }
      .dialog-btn:hover { background: #2a2b3d; }
      .dialog-btn.primary {
        background: #7aa2f7;
        border-color: #7aa2f7;
        color: #1a1b26;
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      .dialog-btn.primary:hover { background: #89b4fa; }

      /* Config panel — slides in from the right */
      #config-panel {
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 600px;
        max-width: 100vw;
        background: #1e1f2e;
        border-left: 2px solid #7aa2f7;
        display: none;
        flex-direction: column;
        z-index: 9999;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
        color: #c0caf5;
        box-shadow: -4px 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      }
      #config-panel.visible { display: flex; }

      .cp-header {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 10px 16px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .cp-title {
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #c0caf5;
      }
      .cp-close {
        background: none;
        border: none;
        color: #565f89;
        font-size: 16px;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 0 2px;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .cp-close:hover { color: #c0caf5; }

      .cp-body {
        display: flex;
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .cp-sidebar {
        width: 130px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        border-right: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 8px 0;
        background: #16172a;
      }
      .cp-panel-btn {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        text-align: left;
        background: none;
        border: none;
        color: #a9b1d6;
        font-size: 13px;
        padding: 7px 14px;
        cursor: pointer;
        font-family: inherit;
      }
      .cp-panel-btn:hover { background: #1a1b2e; color: #c0caf5; }
      .cp-panel-btn.active { background: #1e1f2e; color: #7aa2f7; font-weight: 600; }

      .cp-content {
        flex: 1;
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 12px 16px;
      }

      .cp-group {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
      }
      .cp-group-title {
        margin: 0 0 10px;
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        color: #565f89;
        padding-bottom: 5px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #1e1f2e;
      }

      .cp-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-start;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 6px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #161720;
      }
      .cp-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
      .cp-row-palette {
        display: block;
        padding: 8px 0;
      }

      .cp-label-wrap {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .cp-label {
        display: block;
        color: #c0caf5;
        font-size: 13px;
      }
      .cp-note {
        display: block;
        color: #565f89;
        font-size: 11px;
        margin-top: 2px;
        line-height: 1.4;
      }

      .cp-control {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
      }

      .cp-input {
        background: #1e1f2e;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        border-radius: 4px;
        color: #c0caf5;
        font-size: 12px;
        padding: 4px 8px;
        outline: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        width: 180px;
      }
      .cp-input:focus { border-color: #7aa2f7; }
      .cp-input-number { width: 80px; }
      .cp-file-wrap {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        width: min(360px, 100%);
      }
      .cp-file-text {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .cp-select {
        background: #1e1f2e;
        border: 1px solid #2a2b3d;
        border-radius: 4px;
        color: #c0caf5;
        font-size: 12px;
        padding: 4px 8px;
        outline: none;
        font-family: inherit;
        width: 180px;
      }
      .cp-select:focus { border-color: #7aa2f7; }

      .cp-range-wrap {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
      }
      .cp-range { width: 120px; accent-color: #7aa2f7; }
      .cp-range-label {
        color: #c0caf5;
        font-size: 12px;
        min-width: 32px;
        text-align: right;
        font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
      }

      .cp-switch {
        position: relative;
        display: inline-block;
        width: 36px;
        height: 20px;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .cp-switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; }
      .cp-switch-track {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: #2a2b3d;
        border-radius: 20px;
        transition: background 0.15s;
      }
      .cp-switch-track::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #565f89;
        top: 3px;
        left: 3px;
        transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s;
      }
      .cp-switch input:checked + .cp-switch-track { background: #3d59a1; }
